draft_en.subject: Industrial switches and media converters for your shop - who buys active components?
draft_en.body:
Guten Tag,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 31 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the Industrial-Switch and media-converter categories in your shop, neutral brand, CE/RoHS, from single units: a DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP unmanaged switch, -40 to 75 C - model STI-288GP - $57.4 USD EXW at distributor price (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); an industrial mini Gigabit media converter with SFP slot, STI-110GE, $26.5.

One question: who is the buyer for active components at BR Network, so I send the specs to the right person?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
